TestReplaceAddress::test_serve_writes_du.description: 3 nodes in 3 racks, RF=3 table with 150k rows (15k in debug), flushed; node3 stopped, node4 (same rack) replaces it with no_wait. Once streaming/repair (vnodes) or the tablet rebuild wait (tablets) starts, 1000 more rows are written and counted at QUORUM. After replace: node4 owns node3's tokens (ring per ks/table with tablets), node3 none; then nodes 1,2 are stopped and node4 alone must return all rows with exact content (assert_all, :331). Guards that a replacing node receives writes during streaming (no repair needed after replace).

TestReplaceAddress::test_shutdown_all_an.relevance: The bug mechanism (tokens of a dead node known only via gossip STATUS, lost on full restart) belonged to gossip topology, removed in scylla (ed52d1a292 refuse legacy mode, d35b83bec8 remove gossiper-topology code; dtest d12cf3fe44); topology is now persisted in group0. Replace after full-cluster restart is still valid behavior. rbo param effective but no user data is written, so streaming only covers system keyspaces.
